summary: Runs a Bullet physics world for Actor COMPs, Force COMPs, Impulse Force COMPs, and Constraint COMPs, stepping the simulation at a configured sample rate and updating actor transforms as playback advances.

key_params.name: actors
key_params.note: Actor COMPs to include in this Bullet simulation

key_params.name: forces
key_params.note: Global Force COMPs applied to non-static actors

key_params.name: gravity
key_params.note: Global gravitational acceleration in meters per second squared

key_params.name: dimension
key_params.note: Constrains the simulation to 1D, 2D, or full 3D motion

key_params.name: linmult
key_params.note: Linear velocity multipliers, combined with the Dimension setting

key_params.name: angmult
key_params.note: Angular velocity multipliers, combined with the Dimension setting

key_params.name: initall
key_params.note: Resets bodies and recreates collision shapes

key_params.name: init
key_params.note: Resets simulation state without recreating Actor COMP collision shapes

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Initializes and begins stepping the simulation

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Simulation sample rate that determines timestep

key_params.name: substeps
key_params.note: Additional solver substeps per frame for stability

key_concepts: Bullet Solver COMP is the Bullet physics world that steps Actor COMPs and updates their transforms at the solver sample rate.
Actors can be anywhere in the project, but an Actor COMP can be referenced by only one Bullet Solver COMP.
Global Force and Impulse Force COMPs affect non-static actors; the solver itself runs in a vacuum with no built-in air resistance.
Dimension, linear multiplier, and angular multiplier constrain which translation and rotation axes actors can use.
Initialize Sim and Collision Shapes recreates actor collision shapes, while Initialize Sim only resets simulation state.
common_gotchas: An Actor COMP can be referenced by only one Bullet Solver COMP at a time.
The solver operates in a vacuum; there is no air resistance unless the build adds forces or feedback explicitly.
Initialize Sim and Collision Shapes can be expensive because Actor COMP collision shapes are rebuilt.
Changing actor source SOPs, instancing, or scale-dependent collision setup usually requires collision-shape reinitialization.
Dimension, linear multiplier, and angular multiplier are combined, so a restrictive Dimension menu can override apparently open axis multipliers.
Use Bullet Solver CHOP or Info CHOP channels to inspect body transforms and solver state instead of assuming actor transforms updated as expected.
build_relevance: 2020.20000+ Bullet physics world and solver control
